projection: Equirectangular clon0, Mars 2000 sphere R=3396190 (x=R*lon, y=R*lat)

notes.elev_m: mean of 1 m DEM posts in the cell (m, areoid)
notes.slope_p90_deg: 90th percentile of 2 m-scale slopes in the cell
notes.rough_rms_m: RMS residual of 1 m posts about best-fit plane in the cell

source: USGS Astrogeology, MSL Gale DEM Mosaic 1m v3 (Calef & Parker 2016)
